Property.name: Filename
Property.Description: Name of file to output the document(s) to. May include timestamp specifiers. The %f specifier if present will be replaced with the name of the document's original source stream (stripped of characters illegal in filenames).<p/> See the method Ens.Util.File.CreateTimestamp() for documentation of timestamping options.

Property.name: SuccessEmailSubject
Property.Description: BusinessOperation class for writing HL7 messages to a file. Supports individual or batched messages. This is the subject to use on the success email

Property.name: SucessEmailBody
Property.Description: This is the body that will be included in the success email

Property.name: FailureEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the failure email

Property.name: FailureEmailBody
Property.Description: This is the body that will be included in the failure email

Property.name: valueToBeReplaced
Property.Description: Property to store the values to be replaced

Method.name: outputDocument
Method.Implementation:
Set tSC = ..Adapter.open(pFilename) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set $ZT="Trap" Use ..Adapter.Device Set tSC=..OutputFramedToDevice(pDocument,pSeparators,"",0,..IOLogEntry,.pDoFraming) Use ..Adapter.OldIO Set $ZT="" Exit Set tSC1=..Adapter.close() Set:$$$ISERR(tSC1) tSC=$$$ADDSC(tSC,tSC1) // For this Retry logic to work, Operation Setting "Reply Code Actions" should have a code with R , e.g E=RD or E=RF $$$TRACE("Current Retry Count : "_..RetryCount) set MaxRetry = (..FailureTimeout/..RetryInterval)+1 $$$TRACE(..FailureTimeout_" **** "_..RetryInterval_" ***** "_"Max retry : "_MaxRetry) Set tFileName = ##class(%File).GetFilename(pRequest.OriginalFilename) _ " "
Set currentDate = $ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,3,3) Set extractDate = $EXTRACT(currentDate,0,11) Set extractTime = $EXTRACT(currentDate,11,$LENGTH(currentDate))
do ..valueToBeReplaced.SetAt(tFileName,"%FN") do ..valueToBeReplaced.SetAt(extractDate,"%CD") do ..valueToBeReplaced.SetAt(extractTime,"%CT")
Set updatedSuccessEmailSubject = ..replaceWithParticularFormat(..SuccessEmailSubject) Set updatedFailureEmailSubject = ..replaceWithParticularFormat(..FailureEmailSubject) Set updatedSuccessEmailbody = ..replaceWithParticularFormat(..SucessEmailBody) Set updatedFailureEmailbody = ..replaceWithParticularFormat(..FailureEmailBody)
//Sending Email If $$$ISOK(tSC) { $$$TRACE("Sending alert for successful file transfer.") ;set alert.AlertText=$$$ITFCOMMONSendEmailOnSuccess _ ":emailSubject: "_..EmailSubject_" emailBody:"_..EmailBody do ..ItfSendEmailOnSuccess(updatedSuccessEmailSubject, updatedSuccessEmailbody) do ..valueToBeReplaced.SetAt("Success","%EM") } ElseIf(..RetryCount=MaxRetry) { $$$TRACE("Sending alert for failure in file transfer.") ;set alert.AlertText=$$$ITFCOMMONSendEmailOnSuccess _ ":emailSubject: "_..EmailSubject_" emailBody:"_..EmailBody do ..valueToBeReplaced.SetAt(tSC,"%EM") do ..ItfSendEmailOnError(updatedFailureEmailSubject, updatedFailureEmailbody)
} Quit tSC
Trap Set $ZT="",tSC=$$$EnsSystemError Goto Exit

Method.name: outputSegment
Method.Implementation: If $Case(pSegObj.Name,"FTS":1,"BTS":1,:0) Set pSegObj=pSegObj.%ConstructClone() Do pSegObj.SetValueAt(pCount,1) Quit ..Adapter.PutStream(pFilename,pSegObj,pSeparators)

Method.name: replaceWithParticularFormat
Method.Implementation: Set key = "" For { Set ReplaceVal = ..valueToBeReplaced.GetNext(.key) Set SubBody = $REPLACE(SubBody,key,ReplaceVal) Quit:key="" } $$$TRACE("Done with replacement") Quit SubBody
